vetSays.line: 🛡️ Ernesto, Samuel, Easton, Jayden and Rudra met them at the door — 5 put down. Ernesto, Samuel, Easton, Jayden, Rudra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Scarred Highbeam Deer is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Scarred Highbeam Deer for 171 (Hardlight knife).
Scarred Highbeam Deer's attack hits you for 4.
It should drop — but the light behind Scarred Highbeam Deer's eyes is already gathered. The body won't fall until it fires.
You STRIKE the Scarred Highbeam Deer for 64 (Hardlight knife).
Scarred Highbeam Deer's Antler Sweep hits you for 4.
Easton strikes the Scarred Highbeam Deer.
Easton hits Scarred Highbeam Deer for 47.
The Scarred Highbeam Deer falls.
You cut it down — but the light was already in its eyes. Scarred Highbeam Deer's death throes loose the beam.
Scarred Highbeam Deer's attack hits you for 30.
📺 Easton brought down Scarred Highbeam Deer. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
🛡️ Samuel, Jayden and Miguel met them at the door — 3 put down. Samuel, Jayden, Miguel are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jayden, Miguel, Meera, Diana and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Jayden, Miguel, Meera, Diana, Oliver are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Buffering falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Buffering!
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Static Kite (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader The Static Kite falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Static Kite!
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Grief Counselor shifts, seeking a clear lane.
The Elder Grief Counselor falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Grief Counselor!
🛡️ Annelie and Vito met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Annelie, Vito are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
The Pack-leader Big Big wears Miguel Santos's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big Big (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
🛡️ Didier met them at the door — 1 put down. Didier is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
